items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No.231

TO THE ASSEMBLY:

I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill:

Assembly Bill Number 5359-B, entitled:

    "AN  ACT  to  amend the tax law, in relation to procedures involving
      taxpayer interviews"

    NOT APPROVED

  This bill would amend the Tax Law  to  prohibit  contact  between  the
Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF) and taxpayers when the taxpayer
is  represented  by  an Internal Revenue Service (IRS) enrolled agent or
other representative.

  Current law already requires DTF to recognize IRS enrolled  agents  as
representatives  of  taxpayers.  Yet  this  bill would impose additional
restrictions on DTF that would  impede  payment  processing,  collection
efforts, and basic scheduling and functions. For example, taxpayers with
powers  of attorney on file with DTF would be prohibited from consenting
to, or initiating direct communications with  DTF  on  matters  such  as
making  payment  arrangements,  resolving  process  issues,  or  seeking
assistance from DTF's taxpayer rights advocate. It would also put DTF in
conflict with federal procedures that permit the IRS  to  work  directly
with  a  taxpayer if the taxpayer has initiated contact with the agency.
For these reasons, I am constrained to veto this bill.

  The bill is disapproved.                    (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO
